name: Sariwon
registryAssessment: No local Sariwon registry, cadastral viewer, or public parcel-vector service was evidenced. Official DPRK web material found during discovery was general or for other locations and did not establish a Sariwon parcel source; registryFound therefore remains null.

queries.query: Sariwon North Korea official cadastral map parcel land registry GIS
queries.result: No official Sariwon cadastral map, local land-registry viewer, parcel API, or downloadable parcel dataset was found. Search results included a general Sariwon reference and an official DPRK site for a different city's economic-zone layout, neither of which provides Sariwon parcel geometry.

queries.query: 사리원시 지적도 토지정보 공식 지도 지적측량
queries.result: No Sariwon-specific official cadastral map, parcel service, or public safe ID-plus-geometry response was found. Results were predominantly South Korean cadastral/GIS services or general DPRK legal/institutional material, not a Sariwon source.

officialSources.role: DPRK official Naenara web domain discovered during first-party search
officialSources.observation: The search result available was an official publication for the Sinuiju International Economic Zone, not Sariwon cadastral data. Direct request to the selected domain route failed local TLS certificate validation; no certificate exception was authorized and no service configuration was inferred.

officialSources.role: DPRK official architecture/cultural site discovered during first-party search
officialSources.observation: The reachable site describes the Central Zoo and general map-guide content; no Sariwon parcel layer, cadastral schema, or public parcel endpoint was exposed. Direct curl also failed local TLS certificate validation.

geometryDecision.reason: No safe native parcel identity plus full polygon was obtained from an anonymous public response. The exact WUP point was preserved and was not shifted.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Publicly discoverable Sariwon/DPRK cadastral and map sources reviewed in English and Korean.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official-domain presence and general map material were reviewed, but Sariwon parcel-vector access, schema, CRS, native identity, exact-point containment, and citywide coverage were not verified.
